answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and explicitly confined to the primary region, which matches the March latency restoration via regional failover (memory_b2) better than the other playbooks. Failover can restore availability while keeping writes succeeding if the shift is clean; circuit breaking would fail customer writes (memory_b4), and read-replica routing addressed report/dashboard load rather than settlement writes (memory_b5). A release 2 hours ago is a real alternative (memory_b1 rollback cleared an error spike, not a latency-only regional fault), and peak settlement means any write-path move can threaten in-flight value, so uncertainty is retained and only memory_b2 is pulled to check whether that incident actually resembled this signature. One intervention, so apply failover as a full traffic shift rather than a tiny probe that would leave most writes on the degraded primary.
